title: Help from Public Healthcare Institutions on Bill Issuance for Patients Facing Insurance Claim Difficulties
what_it_is: Help from Public Healthcare Institutions on Bill Issuance for Patients Facing Insurance Claim Difficulties

sections.label: Billing delays and insurance claims
sections.summary: MOH knows of NCCS billing delays causing insurance claim difficulty; NCCS gave letters to insurers, deployed resources, and offers more support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health what support is available for patients at public healthcare institutions where the issuance of billing invoices has been significantly delayed through no fault of the patient and where the delay has led to the patient facing difficulty with making insurance claims for medical bills due to the bill being past the insurer's billing deadline.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: However, the Ministry of Health (MOH) is aware of a few cases where billing delays at the National Cancer Centre Singapore (NCCS) have resulted in patients facing difficulty in making insurance claims.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: NCCS has provided affected policyholders with letters to their insurers to explain the delay in claim submission.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: More resources are being deployed to NCCS to clear the outstanding bills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Policyholders who still face issues with claim submissions after sharing NCCS' letter with their insurers may approach NCCS for more support.

sections.label: Support and portability downsides
sections.summary: Public healthcare institutions offer interim bills and delay letters, and portability was studied with downsides including higher premiums.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As I have explained, in this particular situation with NCCS, they have provided assistance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And in general, the Public Healthcare Institutions do offer support by providing interim bills for insurance reviews and letters to policyholders on reasons of delay in claim submission if this happens, so, there is already support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The other matters raised by the Member relate to issues of portability and that is also something that we had addressed in another question that was raised previously.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have studied this and we have already indicated that there are some downsides of portability and unintended consequences, including increase of premiums.

sections.label: Surfacing unfairness concerns to Ministry
sections.summary: Concerns about unfairness can be surfaced to the Ministry, which can look at how to assist.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: If there are some concerns and issues of unfairness, the matter can be surfaced to the Ministry, and we can take a look and see how we can assist.
